refnamediv.refpurpose: Storage Provider API, a generic interface for acquiring access to storage volumes

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.StorageProvider is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
Storage Provider API, a generic interface for acquiring access to storage volumes

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Storage Provider API, a generic interface for acquiring access to storage volumes interface io.systemd.StorageProvider
# Encodes three classes of storage volumes. This follows the kernel's nomenclature for inode types, i.e. reg, dir, blk. type VolumeType( # Block device storage volumes, block-addressable blk, # Regular file storage volumes, byte-addressable reg, # POSIX file system storage volumes, path/offset-addressable dir )
# Determines whether to open existing or create a new storage volume. type CreateMode( # Open if exists already, create if missing any, # Create if missing, fail if exists already new, # Open if exists already, fail if missing open )
# Acquires a file descriptor for a storage volume. method Acquire( # The name of the storage volume to acquire name: string, # Determines whether to open or create a storage volume createMode: ?CreateMode, # The template to use when creating a new storage volume template: ?string, # Controls read/write access to the storage volume. If false and the storage volume cannot be opened in writable mode the call will fail. If null, storage volume will be acquired in writable mode if possible, read-only otherwise. If true, storage volume will be opened in read-only mode (and fail if that's not possible). readOnly: ?bool, # Dictates what kind of storage volume to request. Some storage volumes can be acquired either as regular file or as block device. In all other cases if this value doesn't match the volume type, the request will fail. requestAs: ?VolumeType, # The size of the storage volume, if one is created. Has no effect if no storage volume is created. createSizeBytes: ?int, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # Returns an index into the array of file descriptors associated with this reply. This may be used to get the file descriptor of the volume. The file descriptor must be properly opened, i.e. not an O_PATH file descriptor. fileDescriptorIndex: int, # The storage volume type, i.e. ultimately the inode type of the returned file descriptor type: VolumeType, # Whether storage volume has been opened in read-only mode readOnly: bool, # Base UID for the returned file descriptor (if directory). If not specified shall default to 0. baseUID: ?int, # Base GID for the returned file descriptor (if directory). If not specified shall default to 0. baseGID: ?int )
# Lists available storage volumes. # [Requires 'more' flag] method ListVolumes( # Specifies a shell glob to filter enumeration by matchName: ?string ) -> ( # The storage volume's primary name name: string, # Additional names aliases: ?[]string, # The type of the storage volume type: VolumeType, # Whether the storage volume is read-only. readOnly: ?bool, # Size in bytes, if known sizeBytes: ?int, # Used bytes, if known usedBytes: ?int )
# Lists available templates. # [Requires 'more' flag] method ListTemplates( # Specifies a shell glob to filter enumeration by matchName: ?string ) -> ( # The template's name name: string, # The type of the storage volumes defined by this template type: VolumeType )
# No storage volume under the specified name exists. error NoSuchVolume()
# A storage volume under the specified name already exists. error VolumeExists()
# No template under the specified name exists. error NoSuchTemplate()
# The specified volume type is not supported by this backend or system. error TypeNotSupported()
# The volume's type does not match the requested volume type. error WrongType()
# This backend does not support storage volume creation of the requested type. error CreateNotSupported()
# This backend or selected volume type requires a storage volume size to be specified if the storage volume does not exist yet and needs to be created. error CreateSizeRequired()
# A storage volume was to be acquired in writable mode, but only read-only access is permitted. error ReadOnlyVolume()
# Template not suitable for this storage volume type. error BadTemplate()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.StorageProvider shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.StorageProvider.Acquire '{}' invokes its Acquire() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.StorageProvider interface was added in version 261.

Acquire(), BadTemplate, CreateMode, CreateNotSupported, CreateSizeRequired, ListTemplates(), ListVolumes(), NoSuchTemplate, NoSuchVolume, ReadOnlyVolume, TypeNotSupported, VolumeExists, VolumeType, and WrongType were added in version 261.
